subject: Week0 MAP template + technical owner checklist (draft)
messages:
From: Michael Stern <michael.stern@cygnus.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@cygnus.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 09:02:00 -0700
Subject: Kick off: MAP and Week0 technical checklist

Hi Jasmine,

Thanks again for the demo last week — the latency profile you showed on the new quantized runtime looks promising for our inference workload. We'd like to move quickly and draft a short mutual action plan so we can align stakeholders and lock a 30-day pilot start date.

Top asks from our side for Week0:
- Confirm API authentication and CORS pattern for our front-end engineers.
- Access to a sandbox model endpoint (read-only key) to run small synthetic tests.
- Data retention and audit log details (SOC2 artifacts).

Can you share a compact MAP template that includes: owners, acceptance criteria, and a lightweight technical readiness checklist? Elena and I will be the primary contacts — Elk for procurement.

Target: pilot kickoff week starting June 7. Is that feasible?

Thanks,
Michael Stern
Head of Platform Integrations
Cygnus AI

Attachments: none
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>
To: Michael Stern <michael.stern@cygnus.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@cygnus.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 10:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kick off: MAP and Week0 technical checklist

Michael — great to hear, excited to move forward. I put together a short MAP draft and a Week0 owners checklist and uploaded both as editable artifacts. High level plan and asks below.

Quick notes:
- Pilot kickoff week of June 7 looks doable from Redwood's side if procurement and SOC2 review finish by May 31.
- Sandbox key: I'll provision a scoped key with rate limits and IP allowlist; 48-hour TTL for initial tests.
- Audit logs: attaching a short SOC2 extract and a one-page log-retention summary.

Draft MAP (link below) includes:
- Week0: onboarding, API keys, test dataset exchange, security questionnaire
- Week1-2: perf validation (latency + token cost) and two validation prompts
- Acceptance: clearly defined SLA thresholds and sample prompt set to run with your infra

Action items I propose this week:
1) Cygnus: confirm owners (API, Front-end, Security).
2) Cygnus: approve sandbox access scope.
3) Redwood: assign technical lead for Week0 (I'll assign Connor).
4) Both: quick sync (30m) to confirm procurement timeline.

Attachments: MAP-week0-owners.xlsx (owners spreadsheet), acceptance-matrix-stub.pdf

Link to draft MAP doc (editable): https://docs.google.com/document/d/1aBcDEF-ghJk_example_MAP_draft

I'll also drop a condensed Week0 checklist into the spreadsheet.

Cheers,
Jasmine Liu
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference

Attachments: MAP-week0-owners.xlsx, acceptance-matrix-stub.pdf
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Michael Stern <michael.stern@cygnus.ai>
Cc: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kick off: MAP and Week0 technical checklist

Quick add from product/CS perspective — looking at the acceptance matrix, we should add a short "quality gate" that captures model output stability for five canonical prompts (we can ship an example set). This saves time during perf validation when teams diverge on what counts as an acceptable hallucination rate.

Also proposed owners table change: add a column for escalation contact (pager/email) and a column for preflight checks owner. I updated the spreadsheet (row highlights).

Connor: assigning you the Week0 infra checkpoints (below). Can you confirm?

Connor's Week0 infra checkpoints (proposed):
- Confirm sandbox endpoint URL and IP allowlist applied.
- Validate key scope (read-only vs read-write) and set TTL.
- Run synthetic latency test (p95 target: <= 120ms for 128-token avg).
- KV cache smoke test using a 5k-token prefix exercise.

Thanks — will follow up after your confirmation.

Best,
Marissa Cole
CS Manager, Redwood Inference
---
Attachments: updated-MAP-week0-owners.xlsx (inline edits)
From: Connor Obrien <connor_obrien@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.ai>, Michael Stern <michael.stern@cygnus.ai>
Cc: Elena Ruiz <elena@cygnus.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 13:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Kick off: MAP and Week0 technical checklist

Thanks Marissa — confirmed on the checkpoints. A couple of clarifications and timelines from engineering:
- Sandbox provisioning: I can enable the scoped key and IP allowlist today; Cygnus to send the public IP range for allowlisting (or we can use a temporary tunnel).
- TTL: 48 hours is fine for initial tests; we can extend after the sync.
- Latency: 120ms p95 is a reasonable target for our quantized model on Redwood Dedicated; will flag if our infra shows higher numbers during initial runs.
- KV cache smoke test: need a 5k token synthetic sample and a small script; I'll add the script to the shared Drive and attach a runbook link.

I've uploaded a short runbook snippet and the synthetic sample generator to the doc. Link below.

Runbook: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B_example_runbook_week0

I'll start provisioning once we have the IPs.

Connor Obrien
Infra Engineer, Redwood Inference

- API owner: Samir Patel <samir.patel@cygnus.ai>
- Front-end: Priya Nair <priya.nair@cygnus.ai>
- Security: Elena Ruiz (me)

Two quick asks from our side:
1) Can you add a short row to the acceptance matrix for cost-estimate per-1000-tokens during the pilot? We want early visibility into unit economics.
2) Can we schedule a 30m sync on Wednesday 19 May at 10am PT to finalize Week0 tasks?

If that works, please send a calendar invite.

Thanks,
Michael Stern
Head of Platform Integrations
Cygnus AI
